adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: the repositories (every branch and tag, `git push --mirror`), their issues and pull requests (the GitHub migration export, or `gh` per repo), the Actions secrets BY NAME — the rows of tooling/channel-register.json `ciSecretRegister`, re-provisioned from the vault, never exported — the environments and their protection rules, branch protection, and the integrations: the Cloudflare Pages Git bindings (tooling/github-org.json `renamePins`), Renovate and every GitHub App installation. Cannot move: the run history and its logs, the GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN (scoped to the old org: the new org needs a new token, an owner step), and the free macOS minutes, which are a property of the PUBLIC repo on the GitHub Free plan.

c8Seam.why: C-8's seam for github is the dispatch CALL (dispatchGithubWorkflows). This port's interface is the NAMES that call addresses — rendered from tooling/github-org.json into services/platform/src/generated/codehost.ts and tooling/generated/codehost.mjs. The call itself stays GitHub's REST shape (capability-register github.exitPlan: a forge move rewrites one fetch).

_why: L2 (port-codehost, 2026-10-03; row O-CODEHOST-NAME-HARD-CODED-IN-33-FILES). The code host is CONFIG: tooling/github-org.json holds the org, every repository and the `renamePins` (the things outside this tree that pin a name), and is the only file that types them. tooling/ports/render.mjs renders the names into services/platform/src/generated/codehost.ts (the platform Worker's dispatch table and OPS_REPO) and tooling/generated/codehost.mjs (every script's default repository); the workflows read `${{ github.repository_owner }}` and `${{ github.repository }}`. tooling/ci/assert-no-dead-repo-names.mjs refuses the org as a literal anywhere else and checks the pubspec, podspec, CODEOWNERS and issue-chooser pins against this register.

The move is rehearsed, not ported further: tooling/ops/org-move.mjs --to <org> --dry-run lists every pin the move must change, read-only. Not L3: there is one host and no suite, and the target is L2 — the forge exit (Forgejo, GitLab) is a runbook (Private/runbooks/switch-vendor.md#codehost), not a second adapter.

CI stays GitHub Actions (tooling/ports/README.md §7: the CI runtime is deliberately not ported — the free minutes are why the repository is public). The vendor `github` is placed HERE; its C-8 seam is the dispatch call, declared above as `c8Seam`.
